chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hajjaj, from Khalid ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not eat from the hunted prey if it falls into the water and dies.

key_terms.الصَّيْد: Hunted prey — game animal killed through the permitted hunting method; its consumption is conditional on meeting specific Islamic requirements
key_terms.فَمَاتَ: And it dies — the resulting death, which is now of uncertain cause (arrow wound vs. drowning), making consumption forbidden
key_terms.وَقَعَ فِي الْمَاء: Falls into the water — the critical condition that triggers the prohibition; introduces uncertainty about the cause of death

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat game that fell into water and died after being hunted in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) — likely Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS) — issues a clear jurisprudential ruling: hunted game that falls into water and drowns before it can be slaughtered or expires from the hunting injury is prohibited from consumption. This ruling addresses a specific scenario in Islamic hunting law (sayd) where the cause of death is uncertain — the prey may have died from the wound or from drowning, and since the permissibility of consuming hunted game requires that the hunter's action (arrow, trained animal) be the proximate cause of death, death by water renders the meat impermissible. This reflects the broader Shia fiqh principle of caution (ihtiyat) in matters involving uncertainty about the permissibility of food.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Hajjaj, from Khalid Bin Al Hajjaj, 
Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Do not eat from the hunted prey which falls into the water, so it dies’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Hajjaj from Khalid ibn al-Hajj aj who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not eat the prey that falls in water and dies.’”
